s: puM, (kvaT + BAve GaY .) duHKam । vyasanam । dravyanizpAkaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ kvATyamAnaM toyaM triviDam । pAdAvaSezam 1 ardDAvaSezam 2 tripAdAvaSezaYca 3 । asya nAma pAriBAzikozRodakam । tatra tripAdAvaSezaM vAtanASakam । ardDAvaSezaM pittanASakam । pAdAvaSezaM kaPanASakam । laGu agnivardDakaYca । tezAM maDye tripAdAvaSezajalaM hemante SiSire ca praSastam । vasante pAdAvaSezajalaM praSastam । Saradi grIzme ca ardDAvaSezajalaM praSastam । varzAyAM azwaBAgAvaSezajalaM praSastam । tatkAle bahudozatvAt । dinapakvajalaM rAtrO guru rAtripakvajalaM divA guru । iti rAjavallaBaH ॥ yaTAsya karaRapraRAlI ॥ “pAnIyaM zoqaSaguRaM kzuRe dravyapale kzipet । mftpAtre kvATayedgrAhyamazwamAMSAvaSezitam ॥ tajjalaM pAyayedDImAn kozRaM mfdvagnisADitam । SftaH kvATaH kazAyaSca niryUhaH sa nigadyate” ॥ iti SArNgaDareRa maDyaKaRqe dvitIyADyAye uktam ॥)
v: kvATa

pu॰ kvaTa--karaRe GaY । 1 atiduHKe hema॰ । duHKena hi cittaM kvayyamAnamiva BavatIti tasya taTAtvam vEdyakokte jalAdeH pAkaBede yaTA BAvaprakASe “pAnIyaM zoqaSaguRaM kzuRRaM dravyapale kzipet । mftpAtre kvATayed grAhyamazwamAMSAvaSezitam । karzAdO tu palaM yAvaddadyAt zoqaSikaM jalam । tatastu kuqavaM yAvattoyamazwaguRaM Bavet । caturguRamataScordDaM yAvatprasTAdikaM jalam । zoqaSikaM zoqaSaguRam । “tajjalaM pAyayedDImAn kozRaM mfdvagnisADitam । SftaH kvATaH kazAyaSca niryUhaH sa vigadyate” । kvATapAnamAtrAmAha “mAtrottamA pale tat syAt triBirakzEstu maDyamA । jaGanyA ca palArdDena snehakATOzaDezu ca । tantrAntare “kvATyadravyapale vAri dvirazwaguRamivyate । caturBAgAvaSizwantu peyaM palacatuzwayam । dIptAnalaM mahAkAyaM pAyayedaYjaliM jalam । anye tvardDaM parityajya prasftiM tu citkisakAH । kkATatyAgamanicCantastvazwaBAgAvaSezitam । pAramparyopadeSena vfdDavEdyAH paladvayam” । azwaBAgAvaSezitasya caturBAgAvaSizwApekzayA gurutvAt dIptAnalaM mahAkAyaM paladvayaM pAyayenmaDyamAgni malpakAyaM palamAtraM pAyayet mAtrottamA palenasyAdityAdi vacanAt । “kATe kzipet sitAScAM SEScaturTAzwamazoqaSEH । vAtapittakaPAtaNke viparItaM maDu smftam । jIrakaM gugguluM kzAraM lavaRaM ca SilAjatu । hiNgu trikawukaM cEva kvATe SARonmitaM kzipet । kzIraM GftaM guqaM tElaM mUtraM cAnyat drayaM taTA । kalka cUrRA dakaM kvATe niHkzipet karzasaMmitam । tatropaviSya viSrAntaH prasannavadanekzaRaH । OzaDaM hemarajatamfdBAjanaparisTitam । pivet prasannahfdayaH pItvA pAtramaDomuKam । biDAyAcamya salilaM tAmbUlAdyupayojayet” । kvATasevanaprakArAdi BAvapra॰ darSitaM yaTA “tatrAnukte praBAtaM syAtkazAyezu viSezataH । muKayaBEzajyasambanDo nizidDastaruRajvare । toyapeyAdisaMskAre tvadozaM tatra Bezajam” । muKyaBezajaM kvATaH tasya sambanDaH pAnam । yataAha “na kazAyaM praSaMsanti narARAM taruRe jvaraM । kazAyeRAkulIBatA dozA jetuM sudustarAH” । AkulIBUtAH pravfdDAH svamArgaM parinyajya itastategatAH । atra kazAyaSabdena kvATo gfhyate । uktASca kvATasya paryyAyAH । “SftaM kATaHkazAyaSca niryyUhaH sa nigadyata, iti । “toyapeyAdisaMskAre nirddozaM tatra Bezajamiti” । tatra taruRajvare Bezajam muKyaBezajaM kvATarUpaM na tu kalkanamuddiSya kazAyaH pratiziDyata iti kalkanaM toyapeyAyavAgvAdikam । nanu “svarasaSca taTA kalkaH kATaSca himaPARwakO । jYeyA kazAyAH paYcEte laGavaH syuryaTottaram” iti vacanAt svarasAdayo'pi kaTaM na niziDyatte । tatrAha “tatra yastu kazAyaH syAtsa varjjyastaruRajvare” iti । caturTamAgAvaSezakaraRenAzwamaBAgaSezakaraRe ca kazAyavarRaH kazAyarasaSca syAt । sa kazAyaH kvATaH sa taruRajvare nizidDaH । kazAyasya lakzaRamAha, “pAdaSizwaH kazAyaH syAt” । ataH zaqaNgAdistaruRajvare na nizidDaH pAkAdUrdDapAke coktalakzaRABAvena kazAyatvABAbAt । aTa taruRajvare kazAyasya dozamAha “dozA vfdDAHkazAyeRa stamBitAstaruRajvare । staByante na vipacyante kurvanti vizamajvaram” । kazAyeRa stamBitA pravfttaye nivAritAH । yata Aha kazAvarasaguRAt “kazAyaH stamBanaH SItorUkzaH pittakaPApahaH” ityAdi । staByante ADmAnaM kurvanti na vipacyante suKena na vipacyante duHKaM dattvAvilambena vipacyante iti yAvat” ।

pain, sorrow, distress, L.

v: kva

a॰ kim + a kimaH kuH । kasminityarTe “ke drumAste kva vA grAme santi kena praropitAH” sA॰ da॰ “sTAyaM sTAyaM kvacidyAntaM krAntvA ca krantvAsTitaM kvacit” BawwiH kvaSabdO svArTAnvitayormahadantaraM sUcayataH । “kvasUryyapramavo vaMSaH kva cAlpavizayA matiH” raGuH । sUryyavaMSakavi prajYayorvizayavizayiBAvo'tyantamasamBavIti gamyate । evamanya trApi yaTAyaTamUqam । tato BavArTe tyap tyak vA kftya kasmin BaDe arTe tri॰ । tataH svArTe ka wApi । kvatyikA । mugDavoDamate asmAt ciccanO kvacit kvacana । “kvacit kvacit vivaraRe gUQaBAvaH prakASyate” vivaraRawIkA । “kvacana patanayogyaM deSamanvizyatADaH” nEza॰ । amaramate dve pade iti BedaH tayoH samAse kAdAcitakapadasidDiH
m: क्व ind. (fr. 1. कु, Pāṇ. v, 3, 12; v, 2, 105) loc. of 2. क = कस्मिन्, or कतरस्मिन्, Mn. x, 66 (क्व श्रेयस्-त्वम्, in whom is the preference?), Kathās. lxxxiii, 36
where? in what place? whither? RV. (sometimes connected with particles अह, इद्, इव, स्विद्) &c.
(connected with नु), Nal.; Mālav.
(with नु खलु), Śak.
(with √ भू, √ अस्) how is it with? what has become of? i.e. it is done with, RV. i, 161, 4; vii, 88, 5; AV. x, 8, 7; ŚBr.; Pāṇ. iii, 1, 12, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
(with गत) how is it with? Nal.; Daś. (क्व गतस् तव मय्य् अनुरागः, what has become of your affection for me ?)
or क्व alone may have the same meaning (e. g. क्व सुखम्, where is happiness? i.e. there is no such thing as happiness, Śāntiś.), Pañcat.; Naiṣ. i, 20
(after a negative phrase) how much less? R. i, 67, 10

क्व — क्व or कुत्र-क्व (implying excessive incongruity) where is this? where is that? how distant is this from that? how little does this agree with that? (e.g. क्व सूर्य-प्रभवो वंशः क्व चाल्प-विषया मतिः, how can my limited intellect describe the solar race? Ragh. i, 2), MBh.; R. &c.
क्वापि, anywhere, somewhere, to some place, in a certain place, Nal.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
sometimes, Sāh.; Hit.
न क्व च, nowhere, never, BhP. iv, 29, 64
न क्व चन, nowhere, MBh. xiv, 560
क्व चिद् = कस्मिंश्-चिद्, Pañcat.
anywhere, somewhere, to any place, in a certain place, Mn.; R.; Śak. &c.
in a certain case, at some time, once upon a time, Nal.; Pañcat. &c.
sometimes Comm.
क्वचिद् — क्वचिद्, here — there, here and there, in various places, MBh. i
now — then, now and then, R. iii, 50, 7; Bhartṛ. i, 4
न क्वचिद्, nowhere, never, by no means, Mn.; Yājñ.; Nal. &c.
क्वचिद् अपि न id., Megh.
यत्र क्वापि, wherever, in whatsoever place, Bhartṛ. iii, 91
यत्र क्व-च id., ŚBr.; ChUp.; Lāṭy.; BhP.
यत्र क्व-चन, in or to whatsoever place
in any case or matter whatever, Mn. ix, 233
whenever, BhP. v, 21, 9
यत्र क्व वाथ — तत्र तत्रापि, wherever — there, BhP. i, 17, 36.
a: क्व — ind. 1 Whither, where; क्वतेऽ न्योन्यं यत्नाः क्व च नु गहनाः कौतुकरसाः U. 6. 33; क्व-क्व when repeated in co-ordinate sentences imply ‘great difference,’ or ‘incongruity’; क्व रुजा हृदयप्रमाथिनी क्व च ते विश्वसनीयमायुधं M. 3. 2; क्व सूर्यप्रभवो वंशः क्व चाल्पविषया मतिः R. 1. 2; Ki. 1. 6; Ś. 2. 18. --2 Sometimes क्व is used in the sense of the loc. of किम् क्व प्रदेशे i. e. कस्मिन्प्रदेशे. (a) With a following अपि it means (1) somewhere, anywhere; (2) sometimes. (b) With a following चित् it means (1) in some places; प्रस्निग्धाः क्वचिदिंगुदीफलभिदः सूच्यंत एवोपलाः Ś. 1. 14; Rs. 1. 2; R. 1. 41; (2) in some cases; क्वचिद् गोचरः क्वचिन्न गोचरोऽर्थः क्वचित्-क्वचित् (a) in one place-in another place, here-here; क्वचिद्वीणावाद्यं क्वचिदपि च हाहेति रुदितं Bh. 3. 125, 1. 4. (b) now-now (referring to time); क्वचित् पथा संचरते सुराणां क्वचित् घनानां पततां क्वचिच्च R. 13. 19.

a: क्वण् — {c1c} P. (क्वणति, क्वणित) 1 To sound (indistinctly), jingle, tinkle; इति घोषयतीव डिंडिमः करिणो हस्तिपकाहतः क्वणन् H. 2. 86; क्वणन्मणिनूपुरौ Amaru. 28; Rs. 3. 24; Me. 36. --2 To hum, warble (as bees &c.); sing indistinctly; Ku. 1. 54; U. 3. 24; Bk. 6. 84.
